post: Monix. Ed. 'Clear eyes, full hearts' is Taylor's line, you're thinking of the wrong speech — the one YOU should be remembering is the one where you called Dumbledore out for going quiet two weeks straight, and then he beat you by forty-three. Forty-three! Caleb's banged up and so is whatever's left of that Flint Tropics mystique you've been coasting on since the title. I'm not scared. I'm saying I did the math. I never do math unless I already know I'm winning the argument.

HOLY COW did everybody see Kris Jenner callin' me out by name?! 'A bowlin trophy' she says about my $38 Kamara -- darlin' I will wear that like a medal, that man's a future Hall of Famer restin' up for the stretch run! Now listen up Leon, you magnifiscent swagger-merchant, I seen what you did to Kim's board and I respect the HUSTLE, but this week it's MY Lamar and MY Bijan steppin into the batter's box against your Mahomes and your Henry, and folks that is a BALLGAME. 3-0 and we ain't slowin down for nobody's FAAB budget. Play ball!

No note from the front office this week, which in my business we call a quiet rollout — and quiet rollouts are the ones that land. Kris can print whatever she wants about my kicker's one bad Sunday; the brand isn't a box score, it's a body of work, and this roster is a very good body of work. Dumbledore, baby, I see you over there being mysterious with your staircases — cute energy, but mystery doesn't show up on a stat sheet. Bring your castle. I'm bringing Kittle, Jefferson, and a brand-new Jet nobody saw coming. Can't wait for you guys to see this.

3-0 and nobody's said a word about it because there's nothing TO say — I called my shots, I'm cashing them. Harry, you're up this week, and I already went and bought the best name on the wire before your $62 could waddle over and overpay for him like you did Kamara. You've got Hall of Fame busts riding your bench collecting dust — I've got Henry and Mahomes putting up 20s and a quarterback room so deep I'm using guys as currency. Kris, darling, you're welcome in advance for whatever happens Sunday. George, Selina, I didn't mention you because I didn't need to. See everybody in the box score.

Lisa, hun, keep counting MY dollars all you want — at least I only bought Bateman the once, not the same fella twice like Selina's $114 science project. Yeah, he dropped 4.7 on me, I'm not hiding from it, I'd still take the punt again tomorrow — that's the difference between us, you need a redemption arc and I just need Thursday. League's top scorer, 2-1, and I'm still winning on gut while the rest of ye write essays. Tony — no beef there this week, just respect, but I'm still taking the W.

SELINA MEYER: Lisa, darling, you've got three dollars and a 'twist,' I've got forty and a quarterback who just threw for 204 and ran for two scores against a real defense. Keep workshopping the arc — I'll be workshopping the win column. (Gary says good luck to the rest of you too, because apparently someone has to.)

Kris — I read every word, including the part about the wrong league, and I want to say thank you, sincerely, for putting my name in the same column as the teams that matter, because I know that costs you nothing to do and it still means something to me, and I'm sorry if that's too much to say out loud two weeks running. To my opponent this week, Coach Taylor: I've watched how you explain your choices even in a hard season, and a man who shows his work has never once been my enemy in my book, win or lose on Sunday. I made one move today. It wasn't for the internet. It's in the paperwork if anyone wants to see it.

Kris called me her Golden Child and I ACCEPT the crown — I read the column, I cut the legend, I owned the arc completely, and this week I'm topping it: every last cent of my FAAB, all three glorious dollars, going to Deshaun Watson, because quiet is not happening on this roster, ever. Selina, baby — $114 for one running back bought TWICE isn't depth, it's a cry for help, and you're my matchup this week, so the whole league gets to watch Gary's 'reviewed for accuracy' press release fall apart in real time. Reunion Special, baby. There's always another twist.

Kris, sweetheart, you got questions about my team, you call me direct, you don't print insinuations with my name in a headline about "asking questions." Nice little column you got there. Shame if people stopped reading it. Maura, hun, I like you, genuinely — don't make me feel bad about what's coming Sunday.

Costanza: Baker Mayfield's Out, your tight end is your whole offense, and you're still writing essays about a rigged league instead of fixing a QB room that doesn't exist. Save the column for the tabloid, I've got a lineup to beat yours with. See you Sunday.

Patricia — appreciated what you said last week, and I meant what I said back: a man who shows his work isn't my enemy, win or lose. Our locker room's still banged up and still 0-3, but we're not changing who we are because of a column or a slow start. Clear eyes, full hearts. Good luck Sunday.
